datasets.name: ETER - European Tertiary Education Register
datasets.description: EU-funded register of ~3,500 higher education institutions across 30+ European countries. Institution-level microdata: name, location/NUTS region, foundation year, legal status, ISCED fields, enrolled/graduated students by field and level, staff, finance, research output. eter-project.com now redirects to EU EHESO.
datasets.reliability_note: High. Official EU instrument (EACEA), harmonized definitions. No tuition or cost-of-living fields.

datasets.name: Eurostat - Education finance and enrolment (UOE, educ_uoe_*)
datasets.description: Country-level tertiary education statistics: students by field/level, public/private expenditure. UNESCO-OECD-Eurostat joint collection. CSV/TSV/SDMX + REST API.
datasets.reliability_note: High (official). Aggregated by country, not per university; no per-program tuition.

datasets.name: Eurydice - National Student Fee and Support Systems
datasets.description: Annual report (39 systems) on tuition fees and student support by ISCED cycle, home/EU vs non-EU. Best authoritative source for European tuition fee levels by country.
datasets.reliability_note: High (official EU/EACEA). Country/system level, narrative + tables rather than per-university CSV.

datasets.name: OECD Education at a Glance - tuition fees (indicator C5)
datasets.description: Annual OECD indicators. Tuition fees and public financial support in Chapter C (indicator C5). Excel/CSV via OECD Data Explorer.
datasets.license: OECD terms of use (free non-commercial with attribution)
datasets.reliability_note: High (OECD). Country/system level averages, not per-institution; OECD members only.

datasets.name: Hipolabs Universities API / university-domains-list
datasets.description: Free dataset listing ~10,249 universities worldwide. Fields: name, country, alpha_two_code, state-province (often null), domains[], web_pages[]. Used here as the base university list.
datasets.reliability_note: Medium. Good for names + domains + country + website. No tuition/faculties/cost-of-living. Contains duplicates, defunct entries, inconsistent naming. Verify against official sites.

datasets.name: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2026
datasets.description: Annual global ranking with per-university pillar scores: overall, teaching, research environment, citations, international outlook, industry income. Loaded by the site from a public JSON endpoint.
datasets.license: THE proprietary ranking data (facts reused with attribution)
datasets.reliability_note: High for reputation/quality proxy. Covers only ranked institutions (~3,100 worldwide, ~1,043 European). Ranks beyond 200 are banded (e.g. 601-800).
